Package dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav

Class DavHandler

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.http.Handler
dev.relism.flash.http.RequestHandler
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.DavHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Bound
Direct Known Subclasses:
NioDavHandler
public abstract class DavHandler extends RequestHandler
A WebDAV mount (RFC 4918, classes 1 and 2). The handler speaks the protocol: methods, properties, locks, the If header, conditional and range requests, the quota (RFC 4331). It serves each request from the DavStorage open(dev.relism.flash.http.Request) returns.

An engine extends it once and implements open (NioDavHandler for a directory); an application extends the engine's handler. Both can override:

  • quota(dev.relism.flash.http.Request) and writable(dev.relism.flash.http.Request), what the caller may do;
  • one method per storage operation (read(dev.relism.flash.http.Request, dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.DavPath, long, long), delete(dev.relism.flash.http.Request, dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.DavPath), ...), called with the request each time the handler uses the storage. Override one to refuse, log or change the operation, and call super to perform it.
